item.title: Slit Keyboards are Worthy!
item.description:
Split keyboards are worthwhile! Now i have enough data points to affirm it!

Despite my initial, and only having tested only for a week i can see many benefits already.

Here is a list of reasons to care, from the most general to the most niche:

  • Standard keyboards hurt! Just keeping your hands apart significantly lowers back pain from typing.
  • Minimal hand movement by default! The separation of the hands forces you to correct inefficient typing habits.
  • The thumb cluster is a great idea! Why the heck we waste our two strongest fingers in a single key?
  • You can be like the jedi knight and build your own saber! Open source variations are totally customizable, so why not?

Combine this and you can get free of pain while becoming an extremely efficient typer.

item.title: Physics Informed Machine Learning for Modelling Natural Circulation Applied to Nuclear Safety
item.description: As the world races to decarbonize energy systems, advanced nuclear reactors emerge as a critical solution, delivering reliable, carbon-free power. A key innovation in these reactors is the use of natural circulation, a naturally ocurring phenomena that happens in fluids in the presence of a gravitational field without any external incluence, this phenomena can be leveraged in the reactor design to passively cool down reactors without the use of mechanical pumps, making then inherently safer.

item.title: Surrogate modelling and PIML
item.description:
I’ve been studying Physics Informed Machine Learning for my master thesis currently, i knew intuitively that these machine learning models are very useful for surrogate modeling, nonetheless i didn’t knew how widely used surrogates were.

For those who don’t know, surrogate modeling (or meta modeling), is the practice of constructing an approximated model out of a high fidelity model - that can be computationally very expensive. They go from the basic idea that you can evaluate the expensive model a few times, and then use a statistical learning process over these results to interpolate a model that is much more cheaper to evaluate. This is very important for tasks such as optimization, parameter calibration, parametric studies, online evaluation (such as is digital twins), uncertainty quantification, and others - because these applications requires often thousands of model executions.

item.title: About
item.description:
Hi, I’m João Pedro Rocha, a Masters Student of Scientific Computing at LNCC (National Laboratory for Scientific Computing, 🇧🇷).

I’m from a Physics background and am now developing research in Scientific Machine Learning, with Physics Informed Neural Networks applied to Transport Phenomena for nuclear reactor safety.

I also do some work with Astrophysical data processing, mainly photometrical time series, acquired with the telescopes managed by the LNA (National Astrophysics Laboratory, also 🇧🇷).
